whyItMatters: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a Gemfile.lock with no `CHECKSUMS` block.
actions: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a Gemfile.lock with no `CHECKSUMS` block.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm Gemfile.lock no longer carries a Gemfile.lock with no `CHECKSUMS` block.
